scenes.text: This factory method registers a Client named alpha. The annotation supplies its explicit bean name.
scenes.phonemes: ðɪs fˈæktɚɹi mˈɛθəd ɹˈɛdʒɪstɚz ɐ klˈaɪənt nˈeɪmd ˈælfə. ðɪ ˌænətˈeɪʃən səplˈaɪz ɪts ɛksplˈɪsɪt bˈiːn nˈeɪm.

scenes.text: Ask for alpha by name, and Spring returns that bean. Add the type argument to check its type too.
scenes.phonemes: ˈæsk fɔːɹ ˈælfə baɪ nˈeɪm, ænd spɹˈɪŋ ɹᵻtˈɜːnz ðæt bˈiːn. ˈæd ðə tˈaɪp ˈɑːɹɡjuːmənt tə tʃˈɛk ɪts tˈaɪp tˈuː.

scenes.text: With just one Client, a type-only lookup returns the same object. Now register beta as a second Client.
scenes.phonemes: wɪð dʒˈʌst wˈʌn klˈaɪənt, ɐ tˈaɪpˈoʊnli lˈʊkʌp ɹᵻtˈɜːnz ðə sˈeɪm ˈɑːbdʒɛkt. nˈaʊ ɹˈɛdʒɪstɚ bˈeɪɾə æz ɐ sˈɛkənd klˈaɪənt.

scenes.text: Both beans have clear names, but both match Client. With no primary selected, this type-only lookup is ambiguous.
scenes.phonemes: bˈoʊθ bˈiːnz hæv klˈɪɹ nˈeɪmz, bˌʌt bˈoʊθ mˈætʃ klˈaɪənt. wɪð nˈoʊ pɹˈaɪmɚɹi sᵻlˈɛktᵻd, ðɪs tˈaɪpˈoʊnli lˈʊkʌp ɪz æmbˈɪɡjuːəs.

scenes.text: Our tests verify named results and type failure. Names identify beans; they don't resolve this type tie.
scenes.phonemes: ˌaʊɚ tˈɛsts vˈɛɹᵻfˌaɪ nˈeɪmd ɹɪzˈʌlts ænd tˈaɪp fˈeɪlɪɹ. nˈeɪmz aɪdˈɛntᵻfˌaɪ bˈiːnz; ðeɪ dˈoʊnt ɹᵻzˈɑːlv ðɪs tˈaɪp tˈaɪ.
